log_level.description: Logging level for the service (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)

bind_host.description: IP address the API service binds to

bind_port.description: Port number the API service listens on

max_request_body_size.description: Maximum HTTP request body size (in bytes) allowed for API requests

policy_file.description: Path to the OpenStack policy configuration file

keystone_auth_uri.description: Public Identity API endpoint used to discover Keystone version and auth token endpoint

project_domain_name.description: Domain name for the Designate project

user_domain_name.description: Domain name for the Designate service user

project_name.description: Project name used to authenticate with Keystone

username.description: Service username for authentication with Keystone

password.description: Password for the Designate service user (should be set via secret manager in production)

keystone_auth_url.description: Admin Identity API endpoint used for token validation

memcached_servers.description: List of memcached server host:port pairs used for token caching

keystone_insecure.description: When true, skip TLS certificate verification for Keystone connections (not recommended for production)

keystone_cafile.description: Path to CA certificate bundle used to verify Keystone TLS connections (ignored if insecure=true)

api_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the API service (0 = automatically set to CPU count)

enable_api_v1.description: Enable Designate API v1 (deprecated, disabled by default)

endpoints.description: List of extra service endpoints (e.g., admin, metadata) to enable

host.description: IP address or hostname to bind this endpoint to

tls_enabled.description: Whether TLS is enabled for this endpoint
